content.text: {"id": "mm6210a3", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "46% were WIC participants and approximately 17% were classified as eligible nonparticipants"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Approximately 91% of eligible nonparticipants had at least one risk marker, and 75% reported at least two markers"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Among all women surveyed, 46% were WIC participants, approximately 17% were classified as eligible nonparticipants"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "WIC participants had higher prevalences of markers of risk for poor maternal or infant health outcomes than eligible nonparticipants"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "cross-sectional", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The two separate surveillance systems, PRAMS and MIHA, conduct annual, population-based mail surveys of women with recent live births"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "All estimated counts, percentages, and 95% confidence intervals were weighted to represent all live births in the participating states"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "using statistical survey procedures that account for complex sample design"}, {"loc": "note", "q": "Percentages and 95% confidence intervals (CIs) weighted to adjust for the sample design and nonresponse."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "This concern was mitigated through nonresponse weighting of the survey data"}], "confidence": "high", "uncertain_fields": ["study_design"]}
